title: Héctor García-Molina Has Died
author: drallison
story_text:
Héctor García-Molina has died. Héctor was a Mexican-American computer scientist and Professor in the Departments of Computer Science and Electrical Engineering at Stanford University.

See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/H %C3%A9ctor_Garc%C3%ADa-Molina for a brief biography.

Héctor was a smart, friendly, almost courtly man. May he rest in peace.
